build_texture_atlas_loader: build a python module to load a texture atlas image from a file path and convert BGR to RGB
create_visualizer_with_texture: create a DensePoseResultsVisualizerWithTexture instance with a texture atlas numpy array for 24 body parts
visualize_densepose_with_texture: visualize DensePose chart results on a BGR image by mapping texture atlas colors to body part regions
extract_texture_grid: extract a 24-part texture grid from the atlas and compute alpha channels for blending
generate_textured_image: generate a textured image by blending texture atlas colors onto a bounding box using IUV coordinates
